root_text: China is currently grappling with a new virus outbreak, five years after the COVID-19 pandemic. This time, the country is seeing a rise in respiratory illnesses, particularly human metapneumovirus (HMPV), as winter approaches. #News

nodes.text: China is currently grappling with a new virus outbreak, five years after the COVID-19 pandemic. This time, the country is seeing a rise in respiratory illnesses, particularly human metapneumovirus (HMPV), as winter approaches. #News

nodes.author: p_communityhub
nodes.text:
Hospitals are overwhelmed, and there are fears of a healthcare crisis.
Young children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems are at a higher risk of developing severe illness due to HMPV. #news

nodes.author: p_communityhub
nodes.text:
There is no specific antiviral therapy or vaccine to prevent HMPV, so prevention measures such as washing hands, covering mouth and nose when coughing or sneezing, wearing masks, and practicing self-isolation if sick are recommended.
#news
